name: multi-agent-debate
title: Debate a motion in fixed rounds, then judge it

comparison.purpose: A pro speaker and a con speaker take turns on a motion for a set number of rounds, then a Jev judge scores both sides and names a winner. Turn order and the round count are machine edges with a MAX_ROUNDS ceiling in the input schema, so no speaker can end the debate or speak out of turn, and nothing depends on a prompt telling the model how many rounds are left.

input.motion: Agent control flow belongs in code, not in prompts.
Remote work is better for software teams.
Cities should ban cars from their centers.
